tasks.subject: Inspect Conky screenshot and config
tasks.description: Review the provided screenshot and locate/read the active Conky configuration to understand how process names are rendered and why they may be missing.

tasks.subject: Check system commands used by Conky
tasks.description: Run the relevant Conky/ps/top command snippets from the configuration to see whether process names are missing at the source or only in rendering.

tasks.subject: Patch and restart Conky
tasks.description: Back up the Conky config, replace the Wayland-buggy ${goto 40} positioning used for process labels with ${offset 40}, restart Conky, and verify it is running with the updated config.

tasks.subject: Measure current Hyprland CPU usage
tasks.description: Collect read-only snapshots of current CPU usage for Hyprland and related Wayland/recording/portal processes, including process tree and elapsed times, without changing any running processes.

tasks.subject: Inspect Hyprland state and logs
tasks.description: Use read-only Hyprland and journal commands to inspect monitors, clients, layers, version/system info, and recent logs for clues explaining high compositor CPU usage.

tasks.subject: Review Hyprland configuration for CPU-heavy options
tasks.description: Read Hyprland-related configuration files to identify enabled effects, refresh/render settings, startup commands, screen capture tools, or other settings that could contribute to high CPU usage. Do not edit files.
